text: {"sql": "SELECT kind, cause, shift_code, false_alarm, COUNT(*) AS incident_count, SUM(downtime_min) AS total_downtime_min, SUM(cars_lost) AS total_cars_lost, SUM(cost_usd) AS total_cost_usd, ROUND(AVG(response_s), 1) AS avg_response_s, MIN(ts) AS min_ts, MAX(ts) AS max_ts FROM sf_ops.incidents WHERE station_id = 'F10' GROUP BY kind, cause, shift_code, false_alarm ORDER BY total_downtime_min DESC", "columns": ["kind", "cause", "shift_code", "false_alarm", "incident_count", "total_downtime_min", "total_cars_lost", "total_cost_usd", "avg_response_s", "min_ts", "max_ts"], "purpose": "Aggregate F10 station incidents by kind, cause, shift, and false alarm flag, ranked by total downtime."}

data.sql: SELECT kind, cause, shift_code, false_alarm, COUNT(*) AS incident_count, SUM(downtime_min) AS total_downtime_min, SUM(cars_lost) AS total_cars_lost, SUM(cost_usd) AS total_cost_usd, ROUND(AVG(response_s), 1) AS avg_response_s, MIN(ts) AS min_ts, MAX(ts) AS max_ts FROM sf_ops.incidents WHERE station_id = 'F10' GROUP BY kind, cause, shift_code, false_alarm ORDER BY total_downtime_min DESC
data.purpose: Aggregate F10 station incidents by kind, cause, shift, and false alarm flag, ranked by total downtime.
